steps.en: Offender searches for fines using a vehicle number
steps.id: Offender mencari fine lewat nomor kendaraan

steps.en: Fines that cannot be paid are marked in the results
steps.id: Fine yang tidak bisa dibayar ditandai di hasil

steps.en: The page tells the offender to log in with Singpass
steps.id: Halaman meminta offender login pakai Singpass
steps.why_en: Only a stored message appears; its wording points to an ID search, and no login button is attached.
steps.why_id: Yang muncul hanya pesan tersimpan; kalimatnya mengarah ke pencarian ID dan tidak ada tombol login di situ.

steps.en: A Singpass login is available on the search page
steps.id: Login Singpass tersedia di halaman pencarian
steps.why_en: The login buttons sit on a separate tab and are not offered from the unpayable fine result.
steps.why_id: Tombol login ada di tab terpisah dan tidak ditawarkan dari hasil fine yang tidak bisa dibayar.

steps.en: After login the offender can view the unpayable fine details
steps.id: Setelah login offender bisa melihat detail fine itu
